asOf.description: Server time the response was built.

indexedAt.description: Scope watermark (witness clock), at or before `firehoseAppliedThrough`: everything witnessed at or before it is reflected for this scope, within the level. Absent before the first firehose batch.

firehoseAppliedThrough.description: Running maximum of the Jetstream witness time of applied events. Absent before the first batch.

firehoseLagSeconds.description: `asOf` minus `firehoseAppliedThrough`; includes the coverage snapshot's age (at most 10 s). JSON number (fractional seconds). Lexicon has no floating-point type, so this field is declared `unknown`; it is always a non-negative number when present.

sourceLagSeconds.description: `asOf` minus the median rev commit time of the last 1000 applied events. Informational. JSON number (fractional seconds). Lexicon has no floating-point type, so this field is declared `unknown`; it is always a non-negative number when present.

firehoseConnected.description: Whether the firehose stream is connected.

freshness.description: What Farsight can claim about the completeness of this response. Every read response carries it.

level.description: Coverage level. Open enum: treat any unknown value as `partial`.

completeSince.description: Witness time since which the level holds.

items.description: Why coverage is not `complete`, or what a `complete` scope excludes. Open enum.

coverage.description: Coverage of the response's scope. Stable contract: `complete` means that, for the response's scope, every record Farsight is not excluding is reflected as of `indexedAt`. For `checkBlocks`, the response-level level applies only to pairs **not** listed in `partialFor`; each pair listed there is `partial` for the reasons given. `partialFor` is a required field (possibly empty). The **only** exclusions are the ones counted in `exceptions`, and an exclusion stops being counted only when the excluded data has been re-listed.

unreachableRepos.description: Actors whose repo could not be listed (terminal failure, or reconcile skipped).

pendingResyncs.description: Actors awaiting a re-list (#sync, desynchronized, reactivation, divergence, poisoned event).

cappedAuthors.description: Actors with records refused or uncounted by a per-author cap or a daily rate.

refusedAuthors.description: Actors with writes refused by a host-bucket cap or the storage budget.

cappedLists.description: Tracked lists whose stored item set is capped.

excludedPendingLists.description: Pending lists without effect on coverage (no relevant listblocks, or beyond the per-owner-key bound).

exceptions.description: The only exclusions behind a `complete` level; always present. An exclusion stops being counted only when the excluded data has been re-listed.
